historical_reviews.deepseek: Names a module but supplies no throughput value or test configuration.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Restores measurement and lane/speed context, distinguishing bandwidth from BER and application performance.

original_test_intent: Measure PCIe Gen5 transport bandwidth of each required NVIDIA endpoint path with the vendor FCT and verify documented directional throughput/efficiency limits while retaining link and SUT health.
original_method: Pin NVDiag bandwidth module/config and stable endpoint/upstream/retimer topology; prove negotiated generation/width; define H2D/D2H/bidirectional traffic, payload/block size, concurrency, warmup, duration/repetitions, units and thresholds; preserve baseline; drain jobs; run under power/thermal/watchdog monitoring; retain raw samples/statistics and compare, then stop traffic and verify link/GPU/errors/usability.
manual_activity: PCIe/performance owner supplies the exact traffic profile and numerical directional thresholds/efficiency basis, approves workload/recovery and owns verdict.
required_inputs: Stable endpoint/upstream/retimer topology and Gen5 width/NUMA map
Dedicated window, job drain, telemetry, watchdog, OOB and recovery
safety_requirements: No floating package or generic benchmark substitution
Verify negotiated link and stable target before traffic
Abort on instability, reset, error delta or unsafe telemetry
Stop all traffic, preserve first failure and never clear or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Compute specified statistics and efficiency with raw evidence
Stop/recover and report without DUT verdict

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic module instruction omits executable config, measured throughput and acceptance basis.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run only pinned vendor `pcie_gen5_bw` FCT for the confirmed path with approved traffic profile, preserving all directional raw samples, configuration and full log.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Bandwidth purpose, ten-minute attendance and twenty-minute estimate remain; actual sample policy follows approved profile.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Report H2D/D2H/bidirectional raw trials and approved statistic with units, negotiated link and theoretical payload basis/efficiency, correlated to telemetry and errors.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns a pass string into a reproducible quantitative link-capacity measurement.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Application performance, linkup and BER evidence cannot substitute for directional PCIe transport bandwidth.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Theoretical line rate differs from achievable payload bandwidth due to encoding/protocol and traffic shape; threshold basis must be explicit.

project_override_considerations: Performance owner defines direction, payload/concurrency and statistics per topology; NUMA and upstream sharing may require per-path thresholds.
expected_evidence: NVDiag build/module/config and stable topology/NUMA/link state
Approved traffic profile, units/statistic/threshold and SKU policy
Complete FCT log plus all directional raw throughput samples/timestamps
Derived statistic, theoretical basis and efficiency per path
Post-traffic usability/recovery, disposition and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently names PCIe Gen5 bandwidth FCT; quantitative configuration is underdefined but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Vendor module, topology and throughput oracle are provisionable; static review is complete.

review_improvement: Adds directional raw measurements, topology/lane context and explicit payload-efficiency acceptance to the vendor FCT result.
independent_technical_reasoning: Bandwidth depends on direction, payload size, concurrency, NUMA placement and shared upstream topology; a single number cannot be compared without that context. Negotiated Gen5 xN state defines a ceiling but protocol overhead makes line rate different from payload throughput. Raw trials plus an approved statistic prevent one transient sample or tool-level pass string from hiding throttling or asymmetric degradation.
